sloka: यश्चैष जाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टं दीप्तं सधूमं परिघं प्रगृह्य ।आयाति रक्षोबलकेतुभूतस्त्वसौ निकुम्भो ऽद्भुतघोरकर्मा ।। ६.५९.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: yaścaiṣa jāmbūnadavajrajuṣṭaṁ dīptaṁ sadhūmaṁ parighaṁ pragṛhya ।āyāti rakṣobalaketubhūtastvasau nikumbho 'dbhutaghorakarmā ।। 6.59.21 ।।।।

translations.english: "There comes Nikumbha, studded with gold and diamonds, shining and smoky, who is the chief of Rakshasa army seizing an iron club, is capable of wonderful and terrific deeds."
